answer: Lottery forensic audit stops sybil factories by giving each identity its own forfeitable bond. Each identity posts 40 credits in a ferrous lock, released only after a clean audit, so one bond never covers two identities. Each epoch the lottery audits 5 percent, checking funding and history in the quartz record; a failed audit forfeits its whole funding cluster, defeating funding-cluster laundering. The kth fake still needs a fresh 40 credits, so 1,000 fakes lock 40,000 with no reuse, while honest agents feel only a zephyr touch.
